snippet.title: C64 Longplay - Subway Vigilante
snippet.description:
In this game, you travel more on trains than you do fighting. Set in my city, London, it looks like the programmers had never been there before as they spell some the names wrong, like, "CHARRING CROSS" instead of "CHARING CROSS", "ENbankment" instead of "EMBANKMENT".

The vigilantes look like they have a bad case of jaundice, and you all wear funky yellow trainers. You have to fight so many of these cheese-faced aggressors to win. There are also some healthy burgers and fizzy drinks to give you energy but no Subway sandwiches, unfortunately.

It does have one rocking soundtrack by Maniacs of Noise, though. 

Published: 1989, Players Premier
Programmers: WOW Software
Graphics: Robert Whitaker (Double Dragon 3)
Design: Michael Jones
